title: Snapshot-on-demand fires a tagged snapshot and emits hetznerSnapshotTaken
asA: operator whose project needs an on-demand recovery point at any moment
iWant: the snapshot-on-demand verb on the provisioner to shell to hcloud image create-image (or the raw-api equivalent) and tag the snapshot with server name and wall-clock time; hetznerSnapshotTaken carries snapshot id and time
soThat: I have a documented on-demand recovery point at any moment without a manual dashboard visit

acceptanceCriteria.description: real-account-snapshot-on-demand.mjs (accountBound: true, skipped without CI_HAS_HETZNER_ACCOUNT) fires the snapshot verb on the throwaway server, then asserts hcloud image list --type=snapshot --output json shows a snapshot tagged with the server name and current wall-clock time; hetznerSnapshotTaken event carries snapshot id and time. Teardown via destroy.mjs.

Snapshot-on-demand upstream failure. Given the hetzner API returns a non-2xx response on hcloud image create-image (for example 429 rate-limited or 503 upstream), when the snapshot-on-demand verb runs, then the facade emits provisionerFailed with { verb: "createImage", apiStatus, retryable } on the event sink and no hetznerSnapshotTaken fires; no orphan snapshot resource remains on the account.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the hetzner API returns 429 or 503 on hcloud image create-image
acceptanceCriteria.then: the facade emits provisionerFailed with { verb, apiStatus, retryable }; no hetznerSnapshotTaken fires; no orphan snapshot remains
